$comment: Product releases, newest first: the one source for every current-release mention on the site. Read from the product's CHANGELOG.md at each tag (docs/claims.md C-REL-1..4). title is the first line of the release's CHANGELOG section (0.6.1 has only a Fixed list). 0.5.0 was never tagged (CHANGELOG: "never tagged or published"), so its tag is null. W6: bundle and sbom are the signed release's facts, each value copied from a command's output on the bundle itself (sha256sum, stat, the .sha256 file, the SBOM's specVersion and components; night C's report quotes them): /verify/ shows them. Releases without them (no bundle on the build host) show none. W8 reads the notes.
